aimbot_desc: Every bullet you hit counts as a headshot
aimlock_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to lock your aim for 0.3 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
anomaly_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to rewind 5 seconds back in time. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
antyflash_desc: You are immune to flashbangs, and your flashbangs last 7 seconds. Grenade limit: 2.
antyhead_desc: You take no damage from headshots
areareaper_desc: You can choose a bomb site to deactivate
areareaper_site_disabled: Bomb site {0} has been deactivated - no bombs can be planted there!
areareaper_used_info: Your skill has already been used.
areareaper_teammates_info: Bombsite {0} has been blocked for planting.
armored_desc: At the start of each round, incoming damage is reduced to a random value between 0.65x and 0.85x of its original amount.
assassin_desc: Attacks from behind deal 2x damage within a 45 degree tolerance.
astronaut_desc: At the start of each round, your gravity multiplier is randomly set between 0.1x and 0.7x.
moneyswap_desc: Choose a player to swap money with
baseball_desc: Your decoy moves at 2x speed, up to 900 velocity, and deals 9999 damage on impact. Grenade limit: 3.
behind_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 20% and 40% to turn the enemy to face the opposite direction.
behind_desc2: Your chance to turn an enemy on hit is: {0}%
berserker_desc: As your health decreases, speed increases up to 2x and damage up to 2x.
blademaster_desc: While holding a knife, torso shots are deflected with 95% chance and leg shots with 70% chance. Deflected velocity multiplier: 0.85x.
blastshot_desc: Press Attack2 with the MP5 to fire an HE grenade dealing 60 damage in a 400 unit radius with 1000 force. Teammate damage is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
bunnyhop_desc: Auto bunny hop with 300 jump velocity, 2x boost, and a maximum speed of 500.
c4camouflage_desc: You are invisible while holding the bomb
carefulbullets_desc: Select a player who takes 5 damage for every missed shot.
carefulbullets_enemy_info: From now on, inaccuracy will literally hurt.
carefulbullets_disable_info: Missing shots no longer hurts you.
catapult_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 20% and 40% to launch the enemy upwards.
catapult_desc2: Your chance to launch an enemy on hit is: {0}%
chicken_desc: You get a chicken model, move faster, and have reduced health.
cypher_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to create or switch to a camera. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
cypher_nospace: The camera must be positioned at right angles to the wall
darkness_desc: Applies a darkness effect to a chosen enemy
deactivator_desc: Choose a player whose skill you want to disable
deaf_desc: Choose a player to mute all sounds for
deaf_enemy_info: Your headphones have left the game.
deaf_player_info: Sound has been disabled for player '{0}'.
disarmament_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 20% and 35% to make the enemy drop their weapon.
disarmament_desc2: Your chance to disarm an enemy is: {0}%
distancer_desc: You can see the distance to the nearest enemy
dash_desc: Perform a second jump to dash with 150 vertical velocity and 600 forward velocity. Any direction: true. Cooldown: 2 seconds.
dracula_desc: Hitting an enemy restores 30% of the damage dealt as health.
duplicator_desc: Choose a player to copy their skill
dwarf_desc: At the start of each round, your size is randomly set between 0.6x and 0.95x.
enemyspawn_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to teleport to the enemy spawn after 10 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
expensiveammo_desc: A chosen enemy pays $50 for every shot.
expensiveammo_enemy_info: Every shot you fire now costs you {0}$.
expensiveammo_player_info: Player '{0}' now has to pay for every bullet.
expensiveammo_select_info: Select a player whose ammo will become expensive:
explodingbarrel_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to place a barrel that explodes for 50 damage in a 600 unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
explosiveshot_desc: Each shot has a random chance between 15% and 30% to create an explosion dealing 25 damage in a 210 unit radius.
explosiveshot_desc2: Your chance to fire an explosive bullet: {0}%
falconeye_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to activate a bird eye camera at a distance of 1000 units.
fastreload_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to reload the weapon you are currently holding
firerain_desc: Throw a decoy to call down a rain of Molotovs
flash_desc: At the start of each round, your speed multiplier is randomly set between 1.2x and 3x.
flashlight_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to toggle a flashlight with 1200 unit range and 1.5x brightness. It blinds enemies within 10 degrees for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 2 seconds.
fortnite_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to create a barricade with 115 health. Cooldown: 2 seconds.
fragilebomb_desc: Shooting the bomb damages it. Bomb health: 1000.
friendlyfire_desc: Shooting teammates heals them for 30% of the damage dealt.
frozendecoy_desc: Your decoy freezes players within 180 units with a 5x slowness multiplier. Grenade limit: 3.
gambler_desc: Select a skill from the list. Refreshing the list costs $150.
giant_desc: Enlarge a chosen enemy to a random size between 1.1x and 1.4x.
giant_desc2: Enlarge an enemy of your choice to {0}x their normal size
giant_disable_info: You are back to your normal size.
giant_enemy_info: You have been enlarged to {0}x your normal size.
giant_player_info: You enlarged player '{0}' to {1}x their normal size.
glaz_desc: You can see through smoke grenades. Active grenade limit: 2.
glitch_desc: Disables the radar for a chosen enemy
glitch_disable_info: Your radar is back to normal.
godmode_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to become immortal for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
healingchicken_desc: You spawn 3 chickens that heal 2 health per tick within 150 units. Tick interval: 16.
healingsmoke_desc: Your smoke heals 1 health per tick within 180 units. Tick interval: 16. Grenade limit: 1.
hermit_desc: Killing restores ammo and 100 health. Effect duration: 1 seconds.
holyhandgrenade_desc: Your HE grenades deal 2x damage with 2x range. Grenade limit: 1.
homingnades_desc: Grenades home toward enemies with 150 strength and 2000 maximum velocity, detonating within 130 units. Grenade limit: 2.
hotbomb_desc: While you are alive, the bomb carrier takes 2 damage every 1 seconds.
hotbomb_disable_info: The bomb is no longer hot.
iana_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to control your hologram for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
illiterate_desc: As long as you are alive, your enemies cannot read
illusionist_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to deploy a replica for 5 seconds while running or 12 seconds while crouching. It deals 20 enemy damage and 10 teammate damage. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
impostor_desc: You start the round with an enemy player model
infiniteammo_desc: You receive infinite ammo for all your weapons
jackal_desc: Every opponent leaves a trail behind them
jammer_desc: Choose a player to disable their crosshair
jammer_disable_info: Your crosshair is back to normal.
jester_desc: Jester mode prevents dealing and receiving damage. The mode changes after a random interval between 10 seconds and 25 seconds.
jetkick_desc: Select a player whose shots push them backwards with 400 velocity.
jetkick_disable_info: Your recoil is back to normal.
jumpban_desc: Choose a player who cannot jump
jumpban_disable_info: You can use your legs again.
jumpcurse_desc: A chosen enemy jumps with 301 velocity whenever a teammate jumps.
jumpcurse_disable_info: You can control your jumps again.
jumpcurse_enemy_info: You now jump whenever one of your teammates jumps.
jumpcurse_player_info: Player '{0}' now jumps whenever their teammates do.
killerflash_desc: Anyone fully blinded for 1 seconds by your flashbang dies. Friendly fire: true. Grenade limit: 1.
knockback_desc: Firing while airborne pushes you backwards by 120 units, up to 1200 speed.
lastgasp_desc: After you die, deal 30 damage to your killer. Can kill: true.
lifeswap_desc: Choose a player to swap health with
longknife_desc: Knife attacks reach up to 4096 units. Friendly fire: true.
longzeus_desc: Zeus attacks reach up to 4096 units. Friendly fire: false.
magneticdecoy_desc: Your decoy pulls players within 180 units with 30 strength. Grenade limit: 3.
magneto_desc: Enemy grenades within 100 units are repelled away from you.
magnifier_desc: Force a chosen enemy to use a 50 degree field of view.
magnifier_enemy_info: Your field of view has been distorted!
magnifier_disable_info: Your vision is back to normal.
magnifier_player_info: Player '{0}' has been forced into zoom mode.
medic_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to restore 50 health. Charges: 3. Cooldown: 1 seconds.
miner_desc: Your HE grenade detonates only when an enemy is within 130 units. Grenade limit: 3.
bankrupt_desc: Choose the player who will lose all their money
bankrupt_select_info: Pick a player to go bankrupt:
deathbomb_desc: You explode upon death for 999 damage in a 500 unit radius. Teammate damage is reduced by 50%.
demoneye_desc: You deal 5 damage to every enemy you are looking at every 1 seconds.
nightmare_desc: Force a chosen enemy into a vision that fades over 0.25 seconds, with exposure between 0.5 and 2.
nightmare_enemy_info: A nightmare is clouding your vision.
nightmare_player_info: You cast a nightmare on player '{0}'.
nightmare_select_info: Select a player to inflict with a nightmare:
ninja_desc: Standing still increases your invisibility by 30%, crouching by 30%, and holding a knife by 30%.
nonades_desc: Grenades deal no damage to you
noclip_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to enable noclip for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Stuck recovery cooldown: 5 seconds.
oneshot_desc: Hitting an enemy instantly kills them
onlyhead_desc: You only take damage to the head
paweljumper_desc: You receive between 1 and 4 extra jumps.
phoenix_desc: After lethal damage, you have a random chance between 20% and 40% to respawn.
phoenix_desc2: Your chance to respawn after death: {0}%
phoenix_respawn: You have been resurrected from the ashes thanks to the power of: CHATCOLORS.REDPhoenix
psychicdefusing_desc: When you are within 80 units of the bomb, you defuse it in 10 seconds.
pilot_desc: Double click jump to fly with 150 fuel. Fuel consumption: 0.64. Refuelling rate: 0.1.
planter_desc: You can plant the bomb anywhere, with 60 seconds added to its detonation time.
poison_desc: Choose a player who takes 1 damage every 0.85 seconds until reaching 30 health.
poison_disable_info: You are now immune to poison.
primaryban_desc: Choose a player who cannot use rifles
primaryban_enemy_info: You can no longer use rifles.
primaryban_player_info: Player '{0}' can no longer use rifles.
push_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 30% and 40% to push the enemy with 400 horizontal and 300 vertical velocity.
push_desc2: Your chances of pushing back the enemy are: {0}%
pyro_desc: Molotov damage restores health with a 1.5x multiplier. Grenade limit: 2.
quickshot_desc: All bullets are fired very quickly
radarhack_desc: Enemies are visible on the radar
rambo_desc: At the start of each round, receive between 50 and 501 extra health.
randomweapon_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to receive a random weapon. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
rezombie_desc: After lethal damage, respawn as a zombie with 500 health and no weapons.
reactivearmor_desc: Armor absorbs the first damage taken, then recharges after 15 seconds.
replicator_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to create a replica. It deals 20 damage to enemies and 10 damage to teammates. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
retreat_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to return to spawn. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
returntosender_desc: The first hit on an enemy sends them back to their spawn
richboy_desc: At the start of each round, receive between $5000 and $15000.
robinhood_desc: Dealing damage steals money using a 35 money multiplier.
rubber_desc: Your bullets slow players for 2 seconds to a 0.2x movement multiplier.
saper_desc: You can plant and defuse bombs faster
secondlife_desc: After lethal damage, you respawn with 50 health.
shade_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 30% and 45% to teleport 100 units behind the enemy.
shade_desc2: Your chances of teleporting behind a hit enemy are: {0}%
silent_desc: Your footsteps and jumps are silent to OTHER players
smoker_desc: Your smoke grenades never run out. Active grenade limit: 1.
sniperelite_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to swap your current weapon for an AWP
soldier_desc: At the start of each round, your damage multiplier is randomly set between 1.15x and 1.35x.
soundmaker_desc: Player screams can be heard every 2 seconds.
spectator_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to spectate a random enemy from 100 units away. Update interval: 0.5 seconds.
swapposition_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to swap places with a random enemy after 10 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
takeammo_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to take the active weapon magazine from a random enemy. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
takeammo_hud_info1: No player with an active magazine was found.
teamteleport_desc: Press [css_useSkill] to teleport to a teammate within 100 units and 10 degrees of your aim. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
teleporter_desc: On hit, you have a random chance between 50% and 60% to swap places with the enemy.
teleporter_desc2: Your chances of swapping places after a hit: {0}%
thief_desc: You can steal a skill from a chosen player
thirdeye_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to activate third person view at a distance of 100 units.
thorns_desc: Attackers receive 30% of the damage they deal to you, capped at 37 damage per shot.
throwingknife_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to throw a knife that deals 9999 damage. Friendly fire: false.
toxicsmoke_desc: Your smoke deals 2 damage per tick within 180 units. Tick interval: 17. Grenade limit: 1.
tripwire_desc: Place a wire up to 400 units long, 30 units high, and 0.7 units wide. Trigger radius: 24 units. Enemies stay visible for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
tripwire_no_wall_info: There are no walls close enough on both sides.
wallhack_desc: You can see enemies through walls
watchmaker_desc: Every grenade throw changes the round time by 7 seconds.
weaponsswap_desc: Click [css_useSkill] to swap weapons with a random enemy. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
weaponsswap_hud_info2: You have no weapon to swap
weightless_desc: Your grenades ignore gravity and fly faster. Active grenade limit: 2.
wildthrow_desc: Choose a player who will have trouble throwing grenades
wildthrow_player_info: Player '{0}' has forgotten all their lineups
wildthrow_enemy_info: You get too excited when throwing grenades.
wildthrow_disable_info: Your memory of how to throw grenades is back to normal.
